amendments.description: Corrected the reporting-only primary anchor count from 12 to the locked 15; K=12 continues to mean pruning after decoder layer 12. The role allocation remains 21 target, 12 context, and 15 anchor tokens.

Assigned the limited-run flag before full MME pair normalization, qualified POPE sample IDs by subset, and cached lossless source images. No benchmark prediction or quality value was generated or inspected.
Added benchmark-specific raw fields, deterministic slow processor loading, exact raw-output rescoring, pinned official evaluator-source hashes, and MM-Vet blocked-external-scoring behavior.

Limited-only manifest preparation now streams large official splits, image_id is never cast as an image payload, and small RefCOCO+ splits use non-streaming loading to avoid a pyarrow finalizer failure. Full preparation semantics and locked row counts are unchanged.

Added a strict 52-cell primary core controller plus 26 separately labelled random-control variance cells (seeds 1 and 2), exact configuration/token-trace validation, serial smoke and measured-memory GPU-soak gates, official rescoring, and the claim-to-artifact ledger. Seed 0 remains the sole headline paired matrix; variance seeds are never mixed with other configurations. All 12 dataset adapters passed structural smoke before registration.

MMMU, VQAv2, and TextVQA now stream only their locked evaluation split and independently reject an actual yielded-row count different from the registered total. This avoids materializing unrelated splits and bypasses a corrupt, unneeded MMMU test-shard cache left by an interrupted compatibility download. No quality output existed or was inspected.

The canonical slow SentencePiece tokenizer does not implement offset mappings. Query-token resolution now aligns the exact query token-id subsequence (including the context-sensitive leading-space variant) against actual processor input IDs. The locked query-max scoring rule is unchanged. One single-example GQA compatibility output was visible after the original resolver failed; it was not used to select or tune any scientific configuration. The repaired resolver passed unit tests and two-record checks on every available locked benchmark, including grounding and multi-image prompts.

Added an isolated official FastV Transformers execution path, metadata-only processor compatibility construction, read-only attention/layer observers, and a disabled-method parity gate. The official selector code is unmodified. A one-example gate proved a 576,576,576,48x29 visual-token trace and exact raw-output parity with FastV disabled; this technical output was not used for configuration tuning.

Stopped and removed only an incomplete recoverable original-LLaVA checkpoint download after proving that it could not coexist with the canonical checkpoint in the 24 GiB shared-memory volume. VisionZip/TransPrune checkpoint work is sequenced after canonical runs; no scientific artifact was deleted.

After all 214354 locked VQAv2 rows had been transformed, the first preparation attempt was interrupted during redundant per-question filesystem existence checks and had not published a manifest. Validation now checks every distinct referenced image artifact once, preserving the same integrity condition while avoiding repeated network-filesystem stats for questions sharing an image. The already cached lossless images are reused on a deterministic full retry; no benchmark prediction existed.

Added thin official VisionZip and TransPrune dataset/output glue plus read-only per-layer sequence observers. Admission requires byte-identical comparison of all 686 scientific checkpoint tensors and deterministic unpruned output parity before either official method can run. The official selection/pruning source is not modified, no quality outcome has been inspected, and exact B=48 is enforced from observed traces.

Removed a separate 3533701120-byte .incomplete Hugging Face weight download under /root/.cache after verifying the complete canonical snapshot remained in shared memory. The removed directory contained no result, manifest, or complete model and is fully recoverable.

The first full RefCOCO structured run stopped at sample 10 because a SentencePiece boundary merge made the query-only slow-tokenizer IDs unobservable as a standalone subsequence. The resolver now uses the pinned checkpoint's locally cached fast-equivalent tokenizer only to observe character offsets, then accepts positions only after exact token-ID alignment against the untouched canonical slow-processor model input. No model input, selector rule, budget, prompt, or scientific configuration changed. RefCOCO full and random-control outcomes had already been produced and inspected; they do not invoke query-token resolution and were not used to tune this compatibility repair. A complete pre-resumption sweep resolved all 8811 RefCOCO-val and all 21373 locked RefCOCO+ queries with zero failures. Incomplete pre-repair run directories are retained as failed-attempt evidence and are not mixed into resumed evidence.
